title: I think I might have been to the hotel once. Is this accurate to anyone else's account of the hotel?
content: The inside was odd, where you would need certain clearances or permission or something to get to higher layers. It was luxury though, with dark and warm colored walls and lighting. Think dark brown wood, red velvet or dark leather furniture, and yellow or orange lighting. The Elevators were more like fancy booths that would take you to the hire levels. I don't remember how, but somehow I got access or permission to the highest level. I went up and wore a fancy dress, and at the top was a super fancy dinner party. The top floor was only really one room, maybe 20x50 ft at the largest. A long dining table had a fancy spread with silverware and everything, not center to the room but slightly off to the left side to make room for people to stand and congregate. The people there were also dressed their best, suits and dresses, some at the table, some up and chatting. No more that 20 were there. Eventually I realized that near the back of the room was a short hall that lead to another room about the same size, or a bit smaller, running parallel to the previous room. I was curious and wanted to know what was over there, so I walked over (there were no doors). Once I turned the corner to the new room, I found another table, this time in the center of the room instead of off to one side, with men in business suits talking to each other about something. Once they noticed I had entered, they stopped and stared at me, like I wasn't supposed to be there. I carefully backed away and went back to the previous room, then deciding that I shouldn't stay on the top level, and quickly descending on the booth elevator. I just had the unnerving feeling that I did something wrong and needed to leave immediately.
